But let me tell you EXACTLY what's happening so you can decide whether to wait or kill it.

✅ What You're Seeing Is Normal Termux Behavior
Termux does not show progress while running a long find command.
So:

“Crawling shared storage…”

…then nothing

…then the cursor appears on a blank line when you hit Enter

IS NORMAL.
It does NOT mean the script crashed.
It does NOT mean it stopped.
It means:
The script is still runni"
